To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the transactive memory approach to organizational memory can be extended to larger groups using an organizational memory information system.
the use of meta-memory and meta-knowledge can be effective in managing organizational memory.

1) the transactive memory theory can be applied to organizational memory; 2) the transactive theory is a useful tool for designing organizational memory information systems; 3) the transactive system is effective in supporting the sharing and use of organizational memory.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and evaluation of an organizational memory information system based on the concept of transactive memory.
the design of information systems for organizational memory.
the design of organizational memory systems that can support the development of transactive memory in large groups.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
organizational memory is the sum of all the information that is stored, created, and used by the members of a group.

the proposed architecture is an effective means of managing organizational memory and that meta-knowledge is an effective means for overcoming the difficulties associated with the extension of transactiveness memory systems to larger groups.
the transactive memory system is an information processing mechanism that allows groups to coordinate their activities and share their knowledge.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a formal architecture for organizational memory directories and have proposed the use of meta-memors to overcome the lack of tacitness in extended transactive memories.
we propose a framework to manage organizational memory using transactive memory and meta-knowledge.
we have developed a formal model for the design and management of transactive memory in large groups.
The main takeaway from our work is that
information technology can help overcome the difficulties of managing organizational memory in extended groups.
transactive memory can be extended to larger groups by using information technology to help manage the meta-knowledge of the system.
information technology can help in managing organizational memories.
